historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works and granted the permit to alter the building at 1404 Golden Gate Avenue, with a condition.

Redevelopment Agency inspectors rated the street fronts of all seven houses of the row, 1400 to 1412 Golden Gate Avenue, of exceptional visual merit, and every exterior in poor condition. The seven houses then held fourteen dwellings between them.
